Retry configured Reader decisions like the shopper's chat call (#375)

SimulatorCompletion.decide made one attempt, on the premise that the
disclosure reader falls back to the chat model when it raises. A
configured Reader has a single judge, and its Gemini fallback only
answers uncertain components, so any failed decision (an in-flight
credit 402, 429, 5xx, timeout) quarantined the episode as
environment_error, and on a selected Reader task failed the whole run.

decide() and the chat call now share one retry loop: the same four
attempts and 5/10/20 s backoff, no retry for a spent key or an account
without credits, and the same failure logging. Retries stop early when
the next attempt can't finish before the earlier of the call's 55 s
budget and the simulator turn's shared deadline, which moves into
simulator_completion so the loop can read it. A network failure after
the retries still raises ConnectionError, so a situation without a
Reader asks its next judge.

Clear the prepared authorization when readV2 refuses its read

Each entry's verification grants the owner-recycle prepared
authorization, and since the entries check only their own custody, a
read can grant it and then be refused by its final check of the whole
custody. readV2's failure path closed the custody but kept the grant,
though the grant is documented as issued only after complete replay.
Both consumers re-issue it behind a full read, so the stale grant was
not reachable, but the contract no longer held.

The failure path now clears the grant. The test refuses a fresh
store's read by replacing the intent file under its custody, as the
memo test does, and requires no grant to remain; before the change the
entry's grant survived the refused read.
